title: A corrupt Thunai memory file reads as empty with HTTP 200, and the next write overwrites it, so notes, reminders and pins are lost with no sign
where: src/lib/thunai/store.ts readMemory (catch returns EMPTY for any error, including a half-written file) and writeMemory
evidence: docs/qa/pass4/evidence/chaos-restart.json (steps 'memory after corrupt file', 'note after corrupt file')
repro: Corrupt data/aws-cache/qa/srv/<instance>/thunai/memory-<id>.json, GET /api/collector/thunai/memory -> 200 with every list empty; POST one note -> file now holds only that note; the old content is gone.

title: With no model key, questions the rules cannot answer (forecasts, drafting a letter) get an unrelated confident answer instead of a plain 'I cannot do that without the model'
repro: 'how many complaints will be resolved by Friday' -> '13,478 incidents resolved, last 90 days' (a past count, no caveat). 'predict how many complaints Adyar will get next week' -> '685 citizen complaints, last 90 days'. 'draft a polite letter to the Commissioner about flooding in Adyar' -> a list of flooding incidents. The thunai agent route returns kind 'none' with no reply for 'summarise the whole city situation in two lines' and the letter request (not checked in the UI).
